summary: The EXP-0031 source calibrated tail 48 at 11/15 completions (73.3%). Three independent 92,160-transition PPO trials then achieved 25/27 frozen tail-48 clears (92.6%), while tails 32, 36, and 40 each retained 27/27 clears. All three optimizer trials retained every earlier boundary, all three game seeds completed, losses were finite, and training plus evaluation had zero controller restarts. Select seed-101002, which scored 9/9 at every evaluated boundary. This accepts the assisted reverse-curriculum expansion only; it is not normal-start Zone 2 evidence.
